eyebrow.zh: 信创采购 · 分数透明 · 可复现

headline.zh:
同一张卷子，
看清各家分数差多少
headline.en:
One fair test,
see how every score was really made

sub.zh: 厂商公布的分数都绑定各自的评测设定。HarnessProbe 把每家的设定还原成同一套，生成一份 apples-to-apples 的对比矩阵，采购可以逐字复跑。
sub.en: Every published score rides a vendor's private test setup. HarnessProbe recovers each setup, normalizes to one common set, and prints an apples-to-apples matrix procurement can re-run verbatim.

title.zh: 把每家的评测设定挖出来
title.en: Surface every vendor's hidden test setup

body.zh: 系统提示、工具调用模板、停止符、推理强度——这些决定分数高低的设定，现在被逐家还原成一份可读的设定档案。
body.en: System prompts, tool-call templates, stop tokens, reasoning effort — the knobs that decide a score are recovered per vendor into one readable profile.

title.en: Same questions, same way to run them

body.zh: 把每家设定套到同一份基准题集上，跑出真正能比的匹配分数，不再是被设定拉高或压低的厂商数字。
body.en: Apply each setup to the same benchmark subset and produce matched scores that actually compare — not vendor numbers inflated or muted by their own config.

title.zh: 一份能复跑的对比报告
title.en: A comparison report you can re-run

body.zh: 生成一份带差距矩阵的 HTML 报告，附带可逐字复跑的设定包——把报告交上去，评审照着原样再跑一遍就能核对。
body.en: Get an HTML report with the gap matrix, plus a repro package — hand it to the review board and they re-run it verbatim to confirm every number.

headline.zh: 采购评审，从一份能复跑的对比开始
headline.en: Start procurement review with a re-runnable comparison

sub.zh: 一条命令生成对比矩阵和复跑包。
sub.en: One command builds the comparison matrix and repro package.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 信创采购级分数对比
tag.en: MIT open source · procurement-grade score comparison
